summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(), gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py, all within 88 characters. Nothing was run, per instructions, and nothing was committed.
